_comment: Copy to config.json. Every key is optional and the server has a working default for each, so copying this file AS-IS is safe and changes nothing.
_comment_discovery: Without scan_roots and without repos, the server auto-discovers: it scans the parent directory of this repo for sibling folders holding EITHER a telemetry/agents/subagents-dispatch.yaml file OR a telemetry/agents/pending/ directory. A folder with an empty telemetry/agents/ does not qualify.
_comment_paths: scan_roots and repos are used as given, so they must be ABSOLUTE paths that exist on THIS machine. The two keys below are deliberately inert (_example_ prefix) because absolute paths from someone else's machine resolve to ZERO repos silently, with no error and no log line. To use them, rename to scan_roots / repos and put in real paths.
_comment_runtime: runtime_database and runtime_ledger accept relative paths, resolved against the repo root, so these three are already portable.
